description: This Java interface 'StatisticsConfig' provides configuration settings for a statistics actor within a distributed system, including methods to retrieve timeouts, intervals, lifetime durations, shard configurations, and a static method to instantiate a default configuration based on actor system settings.

classes.name: StatisticsConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration accessors for statistics reporting in a distributed system. Also contains an enum for known configuration path expressions and defaults.

methods.name: getAskTimeout
methods.description: Returns the configured timeout for asking other cluster members for information.

methods.name: getUpdateInterval
methods.description: Returns the configured interval for updating public statistics.

methods.name: getDetailsExpireAfter
methods.description: Returns the lifetime duration of statistics details before expiry.

methods.name: getShards
methods.description: Returns the list of shard configurations for which statistics are reported.

methods.name: forActor
methods.description: Static method to create a StatisticsConfig instance based on the actor system's configuration settings.
